answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before transacting, vesting over a long horizon so fresh identities cannot act at full weight at once. New identities start in a violet probationary tier with low payment caps and no voting rights, earning higher limits only through verified work and peer attestations over time. Like a river that widens only as tributaries prove steady flow, trust grows gradually. An attacker must fund, wait for, and maintain many separate stakes, making a Sybil flood expensive, slow, and easy to cap.
